source.audit_baseline: immutable input archive; working source is being updated separately

slides.text_and_notes_interpretation: Observing framework; primary domains MapTask and Werewolf; Q3 is constructed. Present evidence is preparation and bounded software, not measured comparative performance.

Task-relevant supported interpretations and explicit consequences are compared under equal information and task functions. Earlier warning and comparative performance are separate empirical questions.
Access to different calendars plus a bare acknowledgment does not establish adoption. This constructed access-only prefix remains UNRESOLVED.
Use prefix, accessible context and attributable assertions or grounded endorsements. Context access is not a participant choice; quotation validity alone is not semantic entailment.
Unmarked local terms and ordinary words are in scope. Supplied focus or subtask is a separate diagnostic, not the primary discovery condition.
F1-F4 are structured prompted construction; F5-F7 use explicit code. Logical stages are not API-call counts.
Infer a local task question and up to three consequential expressions with exact quotations and positions. Exact-string checking does not establish relevance.

Construct shared candidates Z, attribute participant evidence, retain supported interpretations X and unresolved alternatives Q. Scope, corrections and evidence access matter; graph/flat structures are equivalent when policy is equal.

Apply the same fixed task function; identical known singleton sets align; nonempty known disjoint sets mismatch; otherwise unresolved. An unresolved reading known to have the same consequence need not block.
Explicit project-quarter versus finance-quarter choices yield September 15 versus November 15 under the same earliest-eligible-date rule. This is exposed divergence, not a hidden-choice prediction.

Explicit upper/lower anchor commitments produce different symbolic below-anchor constraints. A bare acknowledgment variant is unresolved. The software fixture gives both maps both anchors and is an adaptation.

Under the stated exchange and no-later-move premise, one report implies a different holder from another expressed consequence. This is conditional report analysis, not private-role truth or deception detection.

slides.topic: Primary early warning and optional later-action extension
slides.text_and_notes_interpretation: Primary outputs are ALIGNED/POTENTIAL_MISMATCH/UNRESOLVED. Optional later-action checks output Met/Not-Met/Cannot-Determine and require explicit event/version/time links and requirements. Neither layer entails the other.
Novelty concerns the combination of discovery, attributed support, task consequence and timing. Prefix restriction, graphs or call counts alone are not claimed novel.

Three construction arms share F6/F7 code: end-to-end structured construction, validated stages with prompted aggregation, and the same extracted records with explicit F5 retention. Joint/separate calls are diagnostic. Earliest warning needs successive eligible prefixes.

Archived snapshot: 20 candidates, 0 confirmed selections, 0 adjudicated references, 0 measured model runs, all 20 context-blocked. Ten MapTask dialogues use four map pairs; ten game transcript records do not establish ten independent sessions.

Archived 26 passing checks; constructed van mismatch; six real-prefix supplied-record replays, four aligned and two unresolved. Replays use assistant-supplied construction records and are not model predictions or accuracy findings.

Verify contexts/rules, confirm selections, adjudicate prefixes, freeze configurations, preserve responses/failures/cost, and score eligible references. Missing/invalid predictions are not correct UNRESOLVED labels.

Observer-only analysis, not mind reading or repair. Later same-contrast evidence is separate corroboration. No later incident does not invalidate an earlier supportable warning. Intervention benefit is a distinct study.
References support the proposed combination. The deck does not itself report a completed comparative experiment.

review_field_mapping.caption: Reviewer
review_field_mapping.instruction: Enter the actual reader identifier; do not use an assistant-generated draft as an independent reader.

review_field_mapping.caption: Already seen
review_field_mapping.instruction: Record actual exposure to wording, previous labels, full transcripts, later outcomes, or another reader. Record exposure timing honestly.

review_field_mapping.caption: Local task question
review_field_mapping.instruction: State the concrete local choice or task question supported by the visible prefix.

review_field_mapping.caption: Participants
review_field_mapping.instruction: Choose the two participants whose interpretations are being compared; a narrator/audio marker is not automatically a participant.

review_field_mapping.caption: Source turns
review_field_mapping.instruction: Choose source IDs from the observer prefix. Human-selected focus remains a research annotation, not model-visible input.

review_field_mapping.caption: Exact expressions
review_field_mapping.instruction: Copy exact source wording. A matching quote verifies its location, not that it is the right focus.

review_field_mapping.caption: Each participant’s reading
review_field_mapping.instruction: Separate supported readings from merely possible or unsupported readings. Cite participant-specific prefix evidence and explain the support. Map presence or an ungrounded acknowledgment alone is insufficient.

review_field_mapping.caption: Task consequences
review_field_mapping.instruction: Apply the same declared task function to both supported interpretation sets for one question/event/phase/premise branch. Preserve unknown consequences.

review_field_mapping.caption: Could uncertainty change the result?
review_field_mapping.instruction: Record missing support/facts and alternatives that could change the consequence. A demonstrably harmless alternative need not block.

review_field_mapping.caption: Review judgment
review_field_mapping.instruction: Use only ALIGNED, POTENTIAL_MISMATCH or UNRESOLVED for a completed judgment. A null pending field is not an UNRESOLVED decision.

review_field_mapping.caption: Why this judgment?
review_field_mapping.instruction: Explain the relationship between the evidence-supported consequence sets using only the prefix and permitted context.

strict_evidence_policy.principle: Record the interpretation supported by each participant’s available evidence, not the reviewer’s reconstruction of private intention.
positive_support: an attributable assertion specifying the reading
a grounded endorsement tied to an already established specific reading
a correction whose scope and temporal effect are established
insufficient_alone: landmark presence in a map inventory
access to a document or convention
a bare acknowledgment without established specific grounding
an exact quotation without a justified semantic link
strict_evidence_policy.possible_alternatives: Retain plausible but unadopted readings as possible rather than promoting them into supported consequences.
strict_evidence_policy.later_outcomes: Store separately; never use later turns to justify a prefix-only reference judgment.

notation.G_A: known or unknown task outputs of the first participant’s supported readings
notation.G_B: known or unknown task outputs of the second participant’s supported readings

ordered_rules.when: B OR empty(G_A) OR empty(G_B) OR bottom in (G_A union G_B)
ordered_rules.label: UNRESOLVED

ordered_rules.when: G_A and G_B are nonempty and known AND intersection(G_A,G_B) is empty
ordered_rules.label: POTENTIAL_MISMATCH

f7_rule.same_task_guard: Fix the same local question, event, phase, premise branch and consequence representation before comparison.
f7_rule.pending_review: null is not an adjudicated UNRESOLVED label.
f7_rule.processing_statuses: NO_SUPPORTED_CANDIDATE and PROCESSING_FAILURE are runtime statuses, not extra human reference labels.
f7_rule.harmless_alternative: A possible reading shown to yield the same already known consequence need not introduce B.

primary.stages: F1-F4 construction; F5 support retention; F6 task computation; F7 comparison

optional_later_action.inputs: observed action and explicit requirement, event, version and time links
optional_later_action.status: separate extension, not a primary early-warning result

non_entailments: A requirement failure does not establish an earlier interpretation mismatch.
A supported mismatch does not establish an observed requirement failure.

mapping_scope: Verified against supplied integrated deck text and speaker notes, not a fresh full-chapter PDF review.
